raised.value: €17.2M (about $18-19M) in a 2025 round, after earlier rounds reported at $7.4M and $9.1M

entry.idea: Businesses lose sales and pay staff to answer routine phone calls, so Synthflow built AI voice agents that can answer, make and handle phone calls for a company automatically.
entry.lesson: When an AI feature must work every single time, like a real phone call, owning the unglamorous infrastructure underneath becomes the real product advantage.
entry.name: Synthflow AI

growth.reason: No growth rate is stated, but the company says it has handled more than 65 million calls and raised a bigger round in 2025 than its earlier rounds.

market.reason: Almost every business that takes phone calls for support, sales or scheduling is a potential customer, across nearly every industry worldwide.

tech.reason: It built its own low-latency phone network instead of just wrapping a generic voice API, which is harder for a typical AI startup to copy quickly.

entry.twist: It runs its own phone network instead of just plugging into someone else's, so calls are fast and reliable enough for large companies to trust with real customer calls.
entry.who_pays: Enterprises pay Synthflow to deploy and run AI voice agents for their sales, support and scheduling calls.
entry.why_now: AI voices have become realistic and cheap enough that companies are now willing to let them handle real customer phone calls, not just demos.
